title: The Price of Self-Calibration: Exact Evidence Budgets and Manufactured Blind Sets in Adaptive Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.23254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-calibrating monitors adapt their threshold online to guarantee a prescribed long-run false-alarm rate under arbitrary drift. We compute the price of that guarantee, stating every law with its exact domain of validity. First, the guarantee is an accounting identity, insensitive to what the monitor is meant to detect. Two evidence identities make the cost exact for the online quantile tracker: a persistent step of height $\delta$ yields excess alarm mass within one alarm of $\delta/\eta$, and exactly $\delta/\eta$ pathwise when $\delta$ is a lattice multiple of the gain $\eta$; a ramp of slope $c$ yields a stationary excess rate of exactly $c/\eta$, independent of accumulated size, up to a boundary $c=\eta(1-\alpha)$ coinciding with the alarm-rate cap. translated_title: 自校准的代价：自适应监测中的精确证据预算与人为制造的盲集
translated_abstract: 自校准监测器在线调整其阈值，以保证在任意漂移下达到预设的长期误报率。我们计算了这一保证的代价，并对每条定律给出其精确的适用范围。首先，该保证本质上是一种会计恒等式，对监测器所要检测的对象并不敏感。两条证据恒等式使在线分位数追踪器的代价变得精确：高度为 δ 的持续性阶跃漂移产生的超额报警质量在一报警量内为 δ/η，而当 δ 是增益 η 的格点倍数时，逐路径地恰为 δ/η；斜率为 c 的斜坡漂移产生恰好为 c/η 的平稳超额报警率，与累积规模无关，直至边界 c = η(1-α)，该边界恰与报警率上限重合。其次，该保证证书自身的波动服从一条精确定律：窗口化报警率的标准差为 1/L 量级，而非二项式的 1/√L 量级，因为窗口化质量具有伸缩相消（telescoping）性质。
tldr: 该论文揭示自校准监测器的长期误报率保证本质上是一种与检测目标无关的会计恒等式，并给出精确的证据预算——阶跃漂移造成约 δ/η 的超额报警质量、斜坡漂移造成恰好 c/η 的平稳超额报警率，且窗口报警率的波动为 1/L 量级而非二项式的 1/√L。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the long-run false-alarm guarantee of self-calibrating monitors is a mere accounting identity independent of the detection target, and derives exact evidence budgets—excess alarm mass of δ/η for persistent steps, a stationary excess rate of exactly c/η for ramps, and windowed alarm-rate fluctuations of order 1/L rather than the binomial 1/√L.
